WITH orders AS (SELECT order_id, count(*) AS package_shipments
            FROM commerce_bench_20261108.key GROUP BY order_id)
            SELECT s.state, count(*) AS shipments, sum(o.package_shipments) AS order_fanout
            FROM commerce_bench_20261108.key s JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id
            WHERE s.dispatched_at >= '2026-10-01' AND dispatched_at < '2026-11-09' GROUP BY s.state ORDER BY s.state
